title: Role result — review (design §4 checks, §6.2, §7.2-4, I5)
description: Passed verbatim to `claude --json-schema` for steps with `checks`. = every property of result-work (identical definitions, tests/test_contracts.py checks) + verdict, reviewed, checks, findings. The engine adds: reviewed non-empty and ⊇ the actual changed files outside docs/specs/<N>/ for a diff review, every required check id present, pass with a blocker finding = output-format, a required check with result fail = check-failed, a rule-added check with n/a = output-format, status blocked = stop without looking at verdict (§6.2, I5).

status.description: done = the step's outputs are written. blocked = cannot continue; say why in blocked_by.

outputs.description: Paths of the declared output files you wrote.

requests.description: Procedure change requests (recorded only in stages 0–2, §6). Never put a command in a request.

blocked_by.description: Required (not null) when status is blocked.

note.description: Free text for humans and evolve. The engine never branches on it.

verdict.description: block if anything must be fixed before merge; a blocker finding requires block.

reviewed.description: Every file you actually reviewed. An empty list is a format error.

checks.description: One entry per check id the step asked for.

line.description: null when the finding is not about one line.
